Vaibhav Suryavanshi makes international debut, sparks debate on potential

Cricketer Vaibhav Suryavanshi made his international debut in the 2nd T20I against England. He scored 14 runs off 10 balls, hitting shots against bowlers like Jofra Archer. Suryavanshi's debut has generated discussion among former players and commentators regarding his talent and future prospects. Some, like Kapil Dev, praised his potential, comparing him to Sachin Tendulkar and Virat Kohli, but stressed the need for him to prove himself. Others, like Parthiv Patel, advised team management to be clear about his role if he is not in the playing XI. England's Sam Curran indicated the team had a plan for Suryavanshi.
